notes: Scope: every slot that received a non-null fix from review-AB/review-CD (as applied), the manager's 12-01 Q2 Rose fix, the four chart reorders, and every slot in finale-pass.json (66 distinct slots, 6 of them touched by more than one pass; the current state is what was judged). 'approved' means no P0/P1 on the slot's current state. All fix patches were applied in memory and pass validateNba with 0 errors and the length limits; no repo file was written. Teaching examples: every number, season, unit and derivation in src/content/teaching.ts matches the stored quote, answer and unit of the verified fact it names, all facts are played on or before 2026-11-29 and none is in the reserve, and scripts/nba/teaching.test.ts passes (11/11). No P0 found: no spoiler of another question's answer survives, and the first review's P0 (12-16 Q2 reveal) is fixed. Supports are all played earlier or in the reserve (a daily may print reserve figures per docs/V5.md).
teaching: No mismatches. Minor flavour text in notes (for example Magic as a rookie in the clincher, Kings at ARCO Arena, Murray complementing Jokic) is not in the stored quotes but is not a numeric claim and the numeric derivations (53 - 42 = 11, 36/61 = 59, 100 - 71 = 29, 16-3 second to the 2016-17 Warriors, five league-best win totals 60 to 65) all match.

findings.problem: Finale-pass reference leaks the answer on the opener. The 1986–87 Lakers' 65 is 2 from 67 on a 40–82 ruler (4.8%), the same size of gap the first review flagged as a leak on 12-12 Q5 (4.7%) and 12-20 Q1. A narrow window around 65 wins. question.prompt: The 2018–19 champion Raptors won 58 games. How many did Larry Bird's 1985–86 Celtics win?
question.difficultyReason: Toronto's 58 wins set a modern title-team bar; players judge how far above it Bird's best Celtics side landed.

findings.problem: Finale-pass reintroduces the exact leak the first review fixed. Brunson's 47 is 4 from 43 on a 15–100 ruler (4.7%), in the same spring and as a 'franchise playoff record' pair, so a narrow window just under 47 wins. The prompt is also broken English ('score for Minnesota's in Game 1'), and the context 'franchise playoff records' repeats the record cue.
